questions.stem: Which title fits best?
questions.explanation: The answer is “A Gentle Walk and a Comfortable Evening”. Evidence: After a long day of study, I ask Dad for an outdoor break. We take a walk along the river without trying to reach any special place. We move slowly, watching birds and talking about our day. A light rain begins just as we turn towards home. My clothes are damp when we arrive, so I change into dry ones. Later, I take a shower under warm running water before dinner. The quiet walk and a fresh change leave me ready for a comfortable evening.
questions.parentExplanation: 正确项为“A Gentle Walk and a Comfortable Evening”。原文依据：学习了一整天后，我请爸爸陪我到户外休息一下。我们沿河散步，并不急着到什么特别的地方。我们慢慢走着，看鸟，聊今天的生活。我们刚转身回家，就下起了小雨。到家时衣服潮了，所以我换上干衣服。后来，晚饭前，我在温热的流水下淋浴。安静的散步和清爽的换洗让我能舒舒服服地度过晚上。

questions.stem: What is the passage mainly about?
questions.explanation: The answer is “A group uses a map, notes and a photo to prepare a local guide.”. Evidence: Our class is making a guide to interesting places near school. parallelText.zh: 本记下街道名称，并和地图核对。

parallelText.en: We keep away from the road while choosing what to include in the guide.
parallelText.zh: 我们远离车道，商量把哪些内容放进指南。

parallelText.en: Back at school, our notes and picture help explain why this quiet place is worth visiting.
parallelText.zh: 回到学校后，笔记和照片帮助我们说明这个安静地方为什么值得参观。
